title: Karu Tronomanta Enigma
intro: Huk atiyniyoq reymi, mana hayk’aq rikusqa kamachikuywan saminchasqa, huk sapaq sasachakuypin tarikurqan, chaypin karu llaqtamanta reina karqan. Reyqa maskharqanmi Diospa atiyninta, yachaynintawan rikuchiyta, chaymi mana creenapaq hina sucesota qallarichirqan, chaymi tiempoq, espacioq kamachikuyninkunata mana kasurqanchu. ¿Atiwaqchu kay milagro sucedesqanmanta detallekunata?
clues: Huk kamachikuqmanmi hatun atiyta qoqku, mana rikusqa kaqkunata kamachinanpaq, wayrakunata kamachiyta atinanpaqpas.
Kay kamachikuqmi intita yupaychaq qhapaq reinamanta willakuyta chaskirqan, hinaspan decidikurqan corteman mink’ananpaq.
Manaraq reina chayamuchkaptinmi kamachikuqqa karu suyunmanta hatun atiyniyuq tiyananta apamuyta munasqanmanta qawachirqa.
Huk atiyniyoq jinnimi chay imapas horqonanpaq ofrecekurqan manaraq kamachikuq consejonmanta hatarishaqtin.
Ichaqa, Diospa Qelqanmanta allinta yachaq runan aswan usqhaylla horqoyta haywarirqan, ñawi ch’ipiyllapin chay ruwayta tukurqan.
Chayamuqtinmi kamachikuqqa kamachirqan chay imapas cambianankupaq, chhaynapi reinaq yuyayninta, reparaynintapas pruebanankupaq, palacioman chayaqtin.
verse: It was said to her, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace paved with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, Lord of the worlds." (An-Naml 27:44)
arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
